summary: One-time global state initializer: reads flag byte byte_7CE269; if it is zero, sets it to one and writes the constant 1084227584 into dword_7CE26C. Returns the previous flag value (0 on the first run, 1 on later runs). Called from SessionMenuModeSwitch (0x004A0C60).

operations.description: Read byte_7CE269; proceed with initialization only while it is zero.
Set flag byte_7CE269 to 1 to mark the state as initialized.
Return the prior value of byte_7CE269 (0 if this call performed the initialization, 1 otherwise).

unresolved: Semantics of the constant 1084227584 stored in dword_7CE26C are unknown (no float interpretation is claimed without packet evidence).
Relationship of byte_7CE269/dword_7CE26C to the session-menu state machine is not established beyond the reported caller SessionMenuModeSwitch (0x004A0C60).
Why the caller needs the pre-initialization flag value as a return is unknown.
